archetype: Pastel & Soft (Gen Z) with Neo-Brutalist E1 Twist

headings.scale: text-4xl to text-6xl for Hero, text-2xl to text-3xl for H2, text-xl for cards
headings.import_instructions: Use next/font/google or standard Google Fonts import for 'Outfit'

body.scale: text-base for main, text-sm for labels, uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] for overlines
body.import_instructions: Use next/font/google or standard Google Fonts import for 'DM Sans'

rules: Use #0A0A0A for all main text to ensure high APCA contrast.
Use solid pastel backgrounds with sharp borders for cards and sections.

visual enhancers.borders: 2px solid #0A0A0A on all interactive elements and containers.
visual enhancers.shadows: Hard offset shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]). Never use blurred drop shadows.
visual enhancers.hover_states: Hover state pushes the element up slightly (-translate-y-1) and expands the offset shadow (shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#0A0A0A]). Active state pushes down (translate-y-1) and reduces shadow (shadow-[0px_0px_0px_#0A0A0A]).
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on the main background.

component name.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-xl, high contrast text, sharp borders, offset shadow.
component name.cards: rounded-2xl, white background, sharp border, hard shadow, generous p-6/p-8 padding.
component name.inputs: White background, sharp border, hard shadow on focus, no blur ring, just hard black ring.
component name.badges: rounded-full, bright pastel bg, 1px black border, small uppercase font.

grids.dashboard: Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6). Summary (col-span-1), Main Chart/Plan (col-span-2 or 3), Feed (col-span-1 row-span-2).
grids.marketing: The 'Tetris' Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8) with asymmetrical placements.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, gap-6, gap-8. Containers with borders MUST have padding to prevent text collision.
layouts.navigation: Sticky top-0 nav bar with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-[#FDFBF7]/80, separated by 2px black bottom border.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content and forms. Center hero ONLY if it enhances visual hierarchy.

motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for bento grid cards.
motion.micro_interactions: Checkboxes pop and scale. Progress bars slide smoothly. Avoid 'transition-all', specify exact properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease).

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA or WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against background. All text on colored buttons/cards must be #0A0A0A.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus states: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A0A0A] focus:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.icons: Use iconoir-react or @phosphor-icons/react (bold or duotone variants) to match the bold UI.
media.empty_states: Use abstract 3D pastel shapes as visual anchors in empty states or onboarding.

3d libraries.usage: Optional for this phase. If used, prefer Framer Motion for pseudo-3D transforms or React Spring Parallax for layer separation on the marketing/landing page. Not required for the core dashboard.

image urls.description: Yellow ball and pink object on blue background. Great for Quiz or Tutor section hero illustration.
Smooth pastel abstract 3D shapes. Good for empty states or dashboard welcome card background.
Woman writing on book. Good for a testimonial or landing page feature block.
Man in gray crew neck using laptop. Suitable for 'AI Study Planner' section.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a Neo-Brutalist Soft app targeted at Gen Z (high school students). The UI should NOT feel like a boring corporate SaaS.
Apply 2px solid black borders (border-2 border-[#0A0A0A]) and hard offset shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]) to buttons, cards, and input fields.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the header or floating elements; use solid colors or heavy glassmorphism with borders.

Use pure HTML and Tailwind for complex structural marketing layouts; rely on customized Shadcn components (using pure JS/React, NOT TSX) for complex logic like Modals, Calendars, Dropdowns, and Tables.
Never center text by default, except in strict marketing hero sections.
Include 'data-testid' on all buttons, forms, and key elements to comply with testing rules.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and offset shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js (Note: use .js extension, not .tsx).
